idle: {vessel} has been sitting at {city} with an empty hold and {cash}f in the account. Idle capital is the only kind that never earns anything, and the only kind nobody notices.
{vessel} is riding empty at {city} while {cash}f sits in the account. We are paying for the hull whether it carries anything or not.

credit: {amount}f within {weeks} week{s}, against {cash}f. I say only that the house has never yet been asked to explain a missed obligation, and that reputation is the cheapest asset on the books.
The ladder shows {amount}f due in {weeks} week{s} and the account shows {cash}f. Paper is perfectly drawn and perfectly worthless the day it is not honoured.
chapter: There is business still open that the house has committed itself to: {objective}. Whatever else this season is spent on, that will still be waiting.
For the record, since somebody should keep one: {objective} remains unsettled.

risk_health: {vessel}'s crew is {health} in country that kills Europeans, and I am standing in Bruges. Put me aboard or stop pretending the fever is a matter of luck.
{vessel}'s crew is {health} and there is no physician with them. I can halve what this costs you, but not from here.

risk_sabotage: {vessel} is lying at {city} with cargo in her, and {house} keeps its own people in that port. Things spoil there. They spoil for a reason.
{vessel}'s cargo is sitting at {city}, under {house}'s nose. Move it or expect to be short of it.
risk_uninsured: {vessel} is going out laden and uncovered from a port that would have underwritten her. That is not courage, it is arithmetic nobody did.
You could insure {vessel}'s cargo in port. At sea you cannot. That is the whole of my advice.

convoy: You have {count} hulls in {city} and they are not sailing together. Singly they are prizes. Together they are a convoy, and a convoy gets an escort worth paying for.
{count} ships in {city} and no convoy formed. I have watched stragglers taken. I would rather not watch it again on your wages.
seasonal: {route} is a seasonal passage and she is going out uncovered and unescorted. I will sail it. I am telling you what it is.
{route} in this season, with no escort. It can be done. It is done every year by people who then explain the losses afterwards.

intel_stale: Your newest word from {city} is {age} weeks old and takes {latency} weeks to arrive at best. You are trading there on a letter, not on a price. {cost}f on the courier line would shorten it.
{city} is {age} weeks stale, at {latency} weeks' carriage. I am not saying the price has moved. I am saying you would not know if it had, and that {cost}f would fix that.
intel_unknown: There is a city on your own map you have no word from at all: {city}. Somebody is trading it.
{city} has never once reported to us. Whatever is happening there is happening to somebody else's advantage.

trade: On your own reports: {good} stands at {buyPrice}f in {buyCity} and {sellPrice}f in {sellCity}. That is {margin}f a unit, if the report is still true when you arrive.
Your papers put {good} at {buyPrice}f in {buyCity} and {sellPrice}f in {sellCity} — {margin}f a unit between them. Papers have been wrong before.
household_wages: Wages come to {wages}f next week and the account holds {cash}f. The household will notice. It always notices before the ledger does.
The account holds {cash}f and the household is owed {wages}f. I have kept a house on less, but not for long, and not without somebody leaving.
household_idle: {name} has been idle a long while, and idleness in this house has historically preceded a resignation. Give them something.
{name} has had nothing to do for some while. This house has never kept anyone it did not use, and people work that out.

houses: {house} is at {relation} with us and holds its own port. That is not a rivalry, it is a standing arrangement to be worse off. An agent inside them costs less than a season of being outbid.
You have no one inside {house}, who stand at {relation}. They almost certainly have someone inside us.
